description: This file defines the AlertService interface for managing Alerts within the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, deleting, and notifying alerts, acting as a contract for implementing alert-related functionalities.

classes.name: AlertService
classes.description: Interface defining alert management operations such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and notifying alerts within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: setAlertDAO
methods.description: Sets the AlertDAO implementation for database access.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves an alert object to the database, assigning it a UUID and handling role-based alerts.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an alert by its internal identifier.

methods.name: purgeAlert
methods.description: Completely deletes the specified alert from the database.

methods.name: getAllActiveAlerts
methods.description: Fetches all active (unexpired) alerts for a specific user.

methods.name: getAlertsByUser
methods.description: Retrieves unread and unexpired alerts for a user, or for the currently authenticated user if null.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Finds alerts for a user with specified read and expiration filters.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all unexpired alerts for all users.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves alerts for all users with a specified expiration filter.

methods.name: notifySuperUsers
methods.description: Sends an alert message to all superusers, optionally including an exception cause.
